items.summary: Legislature establishes the Virginia Court of Appeals as a separate State court; current section specifies 21 authorized judges.
items.scope_boundary: Organizational existence and composition are not an unlimited grant of appellate jurisdiction.

items.summary: Hear specified final civil judgments, orders and decrees of Virginia circuit courts, subject to the express § 17.1-406(B) exception and applicable law.
items.scope_boundary: Other statutory categories and interlocutory proceedings require separate authority analysis; exclusions must be retained.

items.summary: Nebraska Court of Appeals is created with six judges in three-judge panels, subject to constitutionally constrained selection and discipline.
items.scope_boundary: Constitutional recognition of an appellate court and enacted organization are distinct from unlimited jurisdiction.

items.summary: Hear qualifying appeals formerly directed to the Supreme Court before September 6, 1991, except statute-defined classes; Supreme Court direct-review and removal procedures remain available.
items.scope_boundary: Capital, life-imprisonment and genuinely presented statutory-constitutionality cases are excluded by statute; related doctrine awaits qualified review.
